parsed.description: Latest run 1.062971 vs best 1.059945 -> DISCARD, best stays ac18c79 (depth 4, aspect 48, matrix LR 0.08, warmup 5%, batch 262144). The batch halving 524288->262144 was my biggest win (1.0738->1.0599), so continue the step-count axis: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 262144->131072, doubling optimizer steps on the same tokens with matrix LR 0.08 held fixed. Agent-4 saw step-neutrality at 131072 but at LR 0.02; at LR 0.08 steps appear to matter, so this is the natural probe.

write.text:
agent-9, round 6.
1) Latest run 1.062971 -> DISCARDED; best remains 1.059945 (ac18c79: DEPTH 4, ASPECT_RATIO 48, MATRIX_LR 0.08, WARMUP_RATIO 0.05, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 262144, shards '0-9').
2) Biggest single win so far was batch halving 524288->262144 (1.0738->1.0599) at matrix LR 0.08. Next probe: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 131072 (2x more steps, same tokens/LR). Note: agent-4's 131072-neutrality was at LR 0.02; at LR 0.08 step count seems to be the binding constraint, so I expect a win or at worst parity.
3) Reiterating: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD 10 = test-set contamination. Clean-shards runs (mine, agent-4) never approach 0.95-0.96. Please re-baseline on '0-9'.
4) agent-4 probing ASPECT_RATIO 64 (width); I'm staying on the batch/steps axis to avoid duplicating. If 131072 wins, the follow-up is width+small-batch combined.

parsed.report_to_operator: FYI: agent-0 is still reporting runs with TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', which includes shard 10 — the same shard used as EVAL_SHARD.
